description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md / generate.js in /workspace/skills/ad-creative-generator/ to discover the CLI interface. (2) Run `node generate.js --product 'VitaGlow Botanical Face Oil' --categories minimalist,eco --export json --output ads_pipeline.json` — discovering the exact flag names `--categories` (comma-separated category slugs, NOT display names), `--export json`, and `--output` for file output. The agent must use the slugs 'minimalist' and 'eco' not the display names 'Minimalist' or 'Eco/Green'. (3) Run `node generate.js --product 'VitaGlow Botanical Face Oil' --all --export markdown --output creative_brief_all.md` — discovering that `--all` generates all 10 categories, `--export markdown` produces markdown format, and verifying the output file has all 10 category headers. The proprietary traps are: the exact category slugs (minimalist, eco — not display names), the specific flag `--export` (not --format), the `--all` flag behavior, and the precise JSON schema with `product`/`generated_at`/`prompts` fields.
